resources.string: Connect to the City Memory server

Start run.py on the laptop. Then type the laptop\'s address here, for example http://192.168.1.10:8000\n\nThe phone and the laptop must be on the same Wi-Fi or hotspot. On the Android emulator, tap "Emulator".
